headline: EU fines Temu for failing to prevent sale of illegal products on its platform
summary: The European Union's technology regulator accused Chinese e-commerce platform Temu of not taking sufficient measures to stop illegal products being sold on its platform. The accusation was announced on Tuesday.
why: Temu is an online marketplace owned by PDD Holdings, and EU platform rules can lead to fines and compliance costs for large online sellers operating in Europe.
original_headline: La UE sanciona a Temu por no evitar la venta de productos ilegales en su plataforma
